FAQ

What is included in “R&D and testing services”?

Organizations involved in aerogel materials research, process development, applied testing, and technical validation rather than finished-product distribution alone.

Why is this useful for sourcing teams?

Because many aerogel projects need technical partners, not just finished-product suppliers.

Can listed organizations be contacted through Aerogela?

Yes. Use the listing page to access Request Quote / Contact Supplier or related claim/contact workflows when available.
